items.effect: lost: not imported; formulas using them keep their saved value and do not update
items.label: named range(s)/name(s)

items.effect: kept: shown from the value saved in the file; the saved value and the formula are kept and written back, and the formula's cell references follow row and column insert and delete (they do not follow anything else, and the value does not update when the cells it refers to change, so it may be out of date; Excel recalculates the formula when the file is reopened, possibly to a different result)
items.label: formula(s) the editor cannot calculate (kept as saved)
